opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection to Scotland), enrolled on or holding an unconditional offer for an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution, and not eligible for government funding towards tuition fees. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students from low-income households in Scotland who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government. Includes a second-degree route for reskilling in skills-shortage subject areas.
